title: Lefthook is classified as not overwriting Entire's hooks, so users get the weaker warning and no permanent fix

worker.report:
Lefthook is now flagged `OverwritesHooks=true`, so `entire enable` prints the "Warning: Lefthook detected" variant. The new test passes. I did not run the rest of the suite.

The advice now names `.lefthook/<hook>/entire` script paths. Without that, it would have printed `lefthook.ymlpre-push:`. Scripts are used because lefthook only passes git's `$@` to scripts, not to `commands:`. The printed lines are Entire's existing hook command lines. They are not wrapped in a lefthook-specific script shape, such as a shebang or a `scripts:` entry.

Some existing tests still assert the old Lefthook behaviour, and I didn't touch them (the task said to run only the narrow test). They will now fail:
- `TestDetectHookManagers_Lefthook` (`hook_managers_test.go:64`) expects `OverwritesHooks=false`.
- `TestHookManagerWarning_GitHooksManager` and `TestHookManagerWarning_Multiple` build Lefthook with `OverwritesHooks: false` by hand, so they still hit the "Note" branch and pass as written. They no longer reflect what detection returns.

I haven't tested `hk`, which the issue says is likely in the same position, so I left it unchanged.

Test added: `TestLefthookOverwritesHooksWarning`
Files changed: `cmd/entire/cli/strategy/hook_managers.go`, `cmd/entire/cli/strategy/hook_managers_lefthook_test.go` (new)

The previous attempt failed because `TestDetectHookManagers_Lefthook` still expected `OverwritesHooks=false`. I changed that assertion to expect `true`, as the issue says it should. The narrow run of `TestDetectHookManagers`, `TestLefthookOverwritesHooksWarning` and `HookManagerWarning` now passes. I didn't run the rest of the package.

Lefthook is now flagged as overwriting hooks, so it gets the "Warning: Lefthook detected" message. The advice names a script under `.lefthook/<hook>/entire` instead of gluing the hook name onto `lefthook.yml`.
